svg.title: Three regression-gate checks on candidate run B: CI threshold, contamination, and distribution drift
svg.desc: A three-panel figure. Left, the CI threshold gate: a 0.70 bar with run A plotted at mean 0.900 and a 95% bootstrap CI from 0.775 to 1.000 entirely above the bar, labelled PASS in emerald, and run B plotted at mean 0.725 with a CI from 0.550 to 0.875 whose lower end crosses below the bar, labelled FAIL in rose. Center, contamination by word 3-gram overlap against training data, flagged at 0.80 or above: E1 at overlap 1.00 is marked LEAKED in rose, while E2 at 0.00, E3 at 0.00, and E4 at 0.20 are marked clean in emerald, all below the flag line. Right, distribution drift by population stability index: run A's score buckets [0.0, 0.5, 1.0] hold counts 1, 2, 17 of 20 and run B's hold 3, 5, 12 of 20, giving a PSI of 0.334, above the 0.25 significant-drift line and labelled SIGNIFICANT. A bottom banner combines the failed CI gate and the significant drift into the decision: BLOCK THE DEPLOY.
